newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $109/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $109/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers continued slow, but a few dressed basis sales were near $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said.
Buyer inquiry fair. Seller interest light at presnt bids.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights ).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs - mostly 109.00. instances to 108.00. (weighted average 108.85).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - mostly 109.00, instances to 108.00. (weighted average 108.83). Confirmed - 1,100 Last Week - 14,800 Last Year - 9,400 For week - 5,600 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 20,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 17,000
